text:
tess-peopleops: Quick heads-up  several interviewers are appearing as "training required" in the scheduler even though they've completed the module. Recruiters are getting blocked when assigning panels.

noah-recruiting: How many folks affected? any pattern (new hires, contractors)?

tess-peopleops: So far 31 interviewers across eng and design orgs, mostly contractors and recent transfers. They have the badge in LMS but scheduler shows training_required=true.

vikas-eng: Could be the new roster-sync mapping. The ATS export added a nested path for training badges (`compliance.training[0].badge_id`) and our mapper expects `training_badge_id` at root. If the mapper reads null it sets `training_required=true` as a safe default.

noah-recruiting: Can you paste a sample ATS roster entry that shows the new shape?

tess-peopleops: Sample sanitized roster row:
```
{
  "user_email": "marta@redwood.com",
  "roles": ["interviewer"],
  "compliance": {"training": [{"badge_id": "badge-intv-2025", "status": "completed"}]},
  "last_synced": "2026-10-05T09:12:00Z"
}
```

trainbot: [roster-sync] 2026-10-05T09:13:01Z WARN mapping.missing_key key=training_badge_id resolved=false

vikas-eng: Confirmed. The mapper got a null for `training_badge_id`. Two fixes: (A) restore path extraction for `compliance.training[0].badge_id` and (B) change scheduler default so it doesn't flip training_required=true when a null badge is present but LMS shows completed. I'll prepare a hotfix for the mapper. ETA 40m.

zoe-ops: Impact: interviews with an unassigned panel show a blocker in the scheduler UI. Recruiters report they can't finalize invites until training flag cleared. We need a quick manual unblock for the 31 pending interviews.

noah-recruiting: I can export list of interview IDs and interviewer emails. We can PATCH scheduler to clear `training_required` for those where LMS shows `completed`. I'll send the list shortly.

trainbot: [roster-sync] 2026-10-05T09:25:00Z INFO dry_run backfill_candidates=31

vikas-eng: Deploying mapper hotfix to staging now. Also adding unit tests for both `training_badge_id` and nested `compliance.training[*].badge_id`. After staging verification we'll run backfill to patch scheduler entries for the affected interviews.

tess-peopleops: For communication, please use this safe template to recruiters/interviewers: "Hi {interviewer}, we see your training recorded as completed. If the scheduler still shows a training requirement, we'll update your interview invite within the hour. No action needed from you unless you see an error." Keep it simple.

noah-recruiting: Sent the list of 31 interview IDs and interviewer emails to zoe and vikas. Also flagged to recruiting ops to pause creating new panels via the new roster-sync flow until resolved.

trainbot: [deploy-bot] 2026-10-05T10:00:00Z user=vikas-eng env=prod change=fix->roster-mapping.extract-training

vikas-eng: Prod mapper fix rolled. Running backfill: script will join ATS roster (completed badges) -> scheduler.interviewers and clear training_required where LMS=completed. Dry-run matched 31 interviews. Backfill will add audit tag `training-backfill-20261005` and a note on each invite.

zoe-ops: Backfill completed. 31 interviews patched. Audit tag present. Spot-checked 6 invites, training flag cleared and recruiters could finalize invites.

tess-peopleops: Thank you. Can we add a monitor that alerts if >5 roster-sync mapping errors for training keys in 1 hour? Also add an integration test that simulates the nested compliance.training array.

vikas-eng: Adding alert and integration test to CI. Also adding a small rollback window policy so mapping changes must pass a mapping-schema check before release.

noah-recruiting: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: closing loop. I'll unpause the roster-sync flow once the alert is green for 24h.

tess-peopleops: Closing  great work all :clap:
